scope: Verify that a batch containing one missing input reports overall failure while still converting its independent valid input, regardless of item order.

control.runtimeAuthoredInputs: The valid minimal AC1021 DXF is authored from SOURCE bytes in a temporary directory. The missing input is an absent path. No DWG/DXF fixture is committed.

cases.expect: exit 1, failure is reported, the valid DXF output exists
exit 1, both success and failure are reported, and the output directory contains only the valid DXF result

assertions: The list file and valid source bytes are unchanged after each invocation.
An error in either position does not prevent the independent valid item from being written.
The process result remains failure when any listed item fails.

validation.build: PASS: CLI executable and local DWG source generator built for the parent CLI slice
validation.test: PASS: python3 -B tests/dwg2dxf_cli_contract_tests.py --converter $PWD/build-gcc/dwg2dxf/dwg2dxf --writer $PWD/build-gcc/libdxfrw_dwg_local_roundtrip --fast-only (103 option controls, 47 batch controls, 2 read-observation controls, 6 partial-read controls, 4 source-disposition controls)

limits: This control covers mixed-batch continuation and aggregate exit status for one valid DXF and one missing path. It does not qualify batch semantic support or every filesystem failure mode.
